facts.text: Sam, I want to see a real sunrise. But dinner first. My father says it helps.
facts.why: Quorra never calls Flynn her father; she calls him Flynn. Her real sunrise line is 'It's how I imagine the sunrise to be', and she asks Sam what the sun is like.
facts.fix: Sam, tell me about the sun while we eat. I'd like to see a real sunrise.

fix_note.text: Sam, tell me about the sun while we eat. I'd like to see a real sunrise.

facts.text: Served at Castor's bar, top of the tower.
facts.why: The End of Line Club is at the top of the tallest tower in the system, and Castor is its owner and host.
facts.fix: Served at Castor's bar in the End of Line Club.

facts.text: Daft Punk on the decks, light cycles out back.
facts.why: Daft Punk do play the club as DJ programs, but no source puts light cycles out the back of it.
facts.fix: Daft Punk on the decks, Castor pouring.

vibe.verdict: Sharp neon club look, but one note is wrong and the best moments are only touched.
